chunks: Al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام was asked about the mukātab, so he said:
What you have stipulated upon him is binding upon him.

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.اَلْمُكَاتَبِ: a slave under a manumission contract
key_terms.شَرَطْتَ: you stipulated or set as a condition
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ: upon him; legally binding on him

ai.seo_question: Are the conditions stipulated in a mukātab contract binding in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the mukātab, a slave under a contractual arrangement for emancipation. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that the conditions stipulated in the contract are valid and binding upon him.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3477 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about a mukatab (a slave under a contract of emancipation).
Imam (as) said: "What you have stipulated upon him is binding."
